images.description: A beautiful white church building with a steeple. Use in the Hero section with a dark blue overlay.
Congregation standing in reverence. Use for 'Tentang Gereja' or Community sections.
Congregation listening to a speaker. Use for 'Renungan & Artikel'.
Person reading. Use for Daily Verse (Ayat Harian) background or devotional section.

Beranda.hero: Dark blue overlay (bg-[#0A2540]/60) over the hero church image. White text, gold CTA. Include language switcher (ID / Batak Toba) floating at top.
Beranda.daily_verse: Bilingual component. Left side: Indonesian. Right side (or toggle): Batak Toba. Pale gold background (#FDFBF7) with an elegant subtle gorga SVG pattern.
Beranda.schedule_cards: Bento grid with 4 cards: Ibadah Minggu, Sekolah Minggu, Naposobulung, Partangiangan. Icons in dark blue, hover states add a gold bottom border.
Beranda.live_stream: A prominent section with a Youtube iframe. Include a pulsing red 'Live Now' badge if active. Dark blue container.
Beranda.latest_news: 3-column grid for articles/news. Image top, title bold dark blue, date text-muted.

pages_and_features.Tentang_Gereja: Generous spacing. Pastor profile as a crisp card. Vision/Mission text large and centered. Service structure in a timeline or grid format.
pages_and_features.Kontak_Donasi: Split layout. Left: Google Maps embed (grayscale/muted if possible) and Address. Right: Donation info (Bank/QRIS) and a big green WhatsApp button.

Admin_Dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (dark blue). Top header with user profile. Main content area with gray background.
Admin_Dashboard.features: CRUD table for Jemaat (Full Name, Gender, Address, Wijk/Sector, Status, WhatsApp). Shadcn Table with search input for Wijk. Export CSV button.
Admin_Dashboard.charts: Recharts BarChart or PieChart showing total congregation grouped by Wijk or Status. Use brand colors (#0A2540, #D4AF37, #1E3A8A).

technical_instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: lucide-react for icons, recharts for admin charts, date-fns for formatting.
Setup routing using React Router (Public routes and /admin protected route).
Use standard Tailwind classes. For Gorga motif, inject an inline SVG with `fill='currentColor'` and `opacity-5` applied within a container.
Implement context or state for Language Switcher (Indonesian/Batak Toba) and apply it to the Daily Verse component.
Admin Login uses JWT (mock or simple implementation for now).
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit'`, `data-testid='nav-beranda'`).
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or native date pickers. Use Shadcn components for forms in Admin dashboard.
Use Montserrat from Google Fonts for headings and Inter for body text.
